claimed: Codex (len) · 2026-11-22T18:12Z · branch mkinney:issue/1473-open-chain-start · plan: prove open-chain start picks and apply the smallest safe fix

Escalated effort:high to effort:max. Claim released. No production code changed.

The remaining contour work needs a pick mapping law and a coordinate format decision.

Open chains: contour_along_chain refuses a pick at the natural start. The new pin an_open_chain_accepts_a_start_pick_at_its_natural_end fails on upstream/main 6e641dac7.

Command: cargo xtask gate test an_open_chain_accepts_a_start_pick_at_its_natural_end --crate camcraft-motion --binary contour_chain_start --exact

Result: 1 step, 1 failed, 0 stalled. The error says: start point (0.000, 0.000): an open chain starts at its end - a picked start is taken only on closed contours yet; clear the start point.

The app offsets source runs before it calls contour_along_chain. See crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_run_side.rs, contour_open_run, and contour_run_stock.rs, contour_open_run_sided. The offset can swallow a terminal leg. A source pick must map to the correct cutter point and preserve the requested climb direction.

Tilted contours: Approach stores the pick as model X/Y only. See crates/motion/src/approach.rs and crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs. Model X/Y cannot identify every point on a vertical plane. The tilted pick needs an explicit coordinate format. Issue #3339 covers shared 3D pick storage.

Item 7 is already split into #3325, #3327 and #3329. The research comments on #1448 name these issues. Items 5 and 6 remain in #1473.

Chosen: keep the named refusals until the mapping and coordinate laws are defined and pinned. Rejected: accept a nearby cutter endpoint or reverse the run without proof. These shortcuts can accept an interior source pick or change the cut direction.

No open PR changes the expected files. No fix, mutation check, quick gate, heavy gate, catalog run or clippy run was completed. No goldens changed.

The local reproducer is /tmp/1473-contour_chain_start.rs. Failure logs are /tmp/1473-pin-red.log and /tmp/1473-pin-red-failure.log. These files are outside the repository. No held production patch or remote branch exists. The temporary worktree and empty local branch are removed.
